hero.subtitle: This template gives counsellors a calm, easy-to-maintain website with pages for services, specialties, fees, FAQs, consultation requests, and blog posts.

approach.title: Counselling copy that is ready to customize
approach.description: The starter language references common counselling approaches. Replace these with your actual modalities, training, and scope of practice.

items.title: Person-centred
items.description: A collaborative relationship where clients are met with warmth, respect, and curiosity.

items.title: Trauma-informed
items.description: Care that prioritizes safety, consent, pacing, and the wisdom of the nervous system.

items.title: CBT-informed
items.description: Practical tools for noticing patterns in thoughts, emotions, and behaviour.

services.title: A practical starting point for private practice
services.description: Use this section to describe who you support, how sessions are offered, and what clients can expect when they reach out.
items: Support for anxiety, depression, relationships, stress, and transitions
Virtual or in-person sessions, depending on your practice setup

cta.title: Ready to make it your own?
cta.description: Update the site config, swap photos, add specialties, publish blog posts, and choose a built-in palette without rebuilding the whole design.
